terms.person: Platform-level human identity, independent of any single tenant
terms.lineConnection: A LINE official account or shared assistant connection namespace
terms.activeWorkspace: Private-chat tenant selection for a multi-tenant person

routing.direct: fail closed on zero memberships; auto-route one membership; require active workspace for multiple memberships
routing.group: route by group binding only; ignore private active workspace

secretPolicy.rawLineUserId: never log or store in Git; hash for lookup; encrypt only when business push requires it
secretPolicy.logs: redact external subjects, tokens and challenge codes
